Objective: Establish Caleb's mundane baseline, execute the summoning ritual, and conclude with the immediate, bureaucratic rejection of his 'Wayfarer' class, setting the stage for his exile.
IntendedChange: Caleb transitions from a maintenance worker in his home world to a summoned hero in Avarra, only to be immediately declassified as a failure and stripped of his heroic status by the kingdom's council.
ProhibitedPatterns: Immediate combat or monster attack upon arrival
Caleb displaying hidden power or fighting back against the council
A dramatic cliffhanger involving a sudden threat or revelation
Romantic or sexual tension with any character
Caleb successfully arguing his case or gaining sympathy

Scenes.Purpose: Establish Caleb's mundane reality and personality through his routine maintenance work, highlighting his competence in fixing things but lack of heroic agency, while introducing the comic engine of bureaucratic absurdity in his workplace.
Scenes.IntendedChange: Ground the reader in Caleb's pre-summoning life, establishing his voice and the contrast between his real-world skills and the fantasy expectations he is about to face.

Scenes.Purpose: Execute the summoning ritual, depicting the transition to Avarra and the initial awe of the magical setting, before shifting focus to the rigid, formal atmosphere of the council chamber.
Scenes.IntendedChange: Move Caleb from his home world to Avarra, establishing the physical and social environment of the kingdom's judgment.

Scenes.Purpose: Conduct the class determination ritual, where Caleb is branded with the 'Wayfarer' class and granted the ability 'Concord,' while the council reacts with visible disdain and bureaucratic indifference to his low ranking.
Scenes.IntendedChange: Reveal Caleb's specific class and ability, establishing the core mechanic of the story (Concord) and the immediate social rejection he faces.

Scenes.Purpose: Deliver the official judgment and sentencing, where the council strips Caleb of all support, resources, and heroic status, declaring him a failed hero and sentencing him to exile beyond the frontier as bait for monsters.
Scenes.IntendedChange: Complete the short arc's objective of rejection, establishing Caleb's new status as an outcast and setting up the immediate conflict of his survival.
